description:
Publish a truthful post-PPC baseline scorecard and clean up the legacy 64c88ae4 publication state.

## Background

The original 64c88ae4 report predates the PPC follow-up evidence and its report child a9ab0a4f failed review on stale table semantics, stale environment docs, and stale reference-status labels.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] The benchmark publication distinguishes measured, N/A, slow/nightly, harness-scope gap, and optimization-gap cells without contradictory legends.
- [hard] 64c88ae4 and a9ab0a4f descriptions and linked docs accurately state that baseline publication is separate from SOTA gap closure.
- [hard] a9ab0a4f gates pass and the corrected scorecard is linked to the relevant JIT issues.

documents.label: Legacy 64c88ae4 benchmark report to clean up
